notes: Original measurement by the authors on an H-Sorb 2600T high-pressure gas adsorption instrument with sample-volume calibration; the paper does not use the word 'volumetric', so I1 rests on the described procedure (only the empty/loaded sample tube is weighed on a balance, uptake comes from the adsorption program), i.e. volumetric. Measured uptake at 80 bar: ZD-HK-AC 0.91 wt% (Table 4, Fig. 4a); ZD-HK3-AC 0.91 wt% (Table 5, Fig. 4b); cycling isotherms in Fig. 8. Temperature: 'room temperature' in text; 303 K only in Table 7 (This work row). Internal inconsistency: Section 3.2 (p. 6) says ZD-HK-AC reaches 1.26 wt% at 80 bar, whereas Table 4, Table 5 and Fig. 4 give 0.91 wt%. I2: no carbon mass fraction is reported for the final activated carbons (raw coal C 60.36 wt%, Table 1); met because the sorbent is a KOH/NaOH-activated, HCl-washed carbon the paper calls activated carbon. BET and Langmuir areas measured by N2 at 77 K on the same samples (Section 2.3, Tables 4 and 5). No supplementary file in the input. record.json is_retracted false; no retraction wording in the text (searched). Not a review. No statement that the uptake values were published before.
